description: Rank leaf taxa recorded in an area and period, most-observed first. Includes hybrids and coarser identifications; subspecies roll up to their species. An area is given in exactly one form: place_id, the lat/lng/radius triple in kilometres, or a four-corner bounding box. Narrow to a clade by passing taxon_id, e.g. the birds of a park, or to one observer or one project by user_id, user_login, or project_id. Defaults to research-grade, wild-only records and echoes those defaults back. For the most active people rather than the most recorded taxa, use inaturalist_get_leaderboard.

captive.description: True returns captive and cultivated records only — zoo animals, garden plantings; false returns wild records only. Defaults to false. Captive records are graded casual, so pair true with "casual" in quality_grade.

csi.description: IUCN-normalised conservation status codes. Matches global statuses plus statuses listed at exactly place_id, excluding ancestor-place listings; decode with inaturalist_list_reference topic conservation_status_codes.

d1.description: Earliest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Must be on or before d2.

endemic.description: Filter the observation’s indexed taxon as endemic at its location.

hrank.description: Highest (coarsest) identification rank level to accept. Must be at or above lrank.

iconic_taxa.description: Broad organism groups, by their scientific iconic-taxon name — Aves, not "Birds"; inaturalist_list_reference topic iconic_taxa lists them.

ident_user_id.description: Restrict to records carrying an identification by this user, by numeric user id or login from inaturalist_resolve_name type user. The user’s own observations count.

introduced.description: Filter the observation’s indexed taxon as introduced at its location.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lng and radius.

lng.description: Longitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lat and radius.

lrank.description: Lowest (finest) identification rank level to accept. Equal bounds select a level, including ranks sharing that level such as species and hybrid.

month.description: Observed calendar months, 1–12, matched as alternatives.

native.description: Filter the observation’s indexed taxon as native at its location.

nelat.description: North-east corner latitude of the bounding box, at or north of swlat. All four corners or none.

nelng.description: North-east corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none. West of swlng is accepted: it describes a box crossing the antimeridian.

per_page.description: Taxa per page. Raise page to continue the ranking. Ceiling: 50; oversized values are clamped.

place_id.description: Numeric iNaturalist place id from inaturalist_find_places. Mutually exclusive with the lat/lng/radius triple and the bounding box.

project_id.description: Restrict to observations in one project, by numeric project id from inaturalist_resolve_name type project.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tiers to include, normalized to unique values in first-appearance order. Defaults to research-grade only; adding "needs_id" roughly doubles the corpus and lowers identification confidence.

radius.description: Search radius around lat/lng, in KILOMETRES, greater than 0. Requires lat and lng. Ceiling: 20040; oversized values are clamped with notice.

rank.description: Exact identification rank. Unlike hrank/lrank, species does not also select hybrid.

swlat.description: South-west corner latitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

swlng.description: South-west corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

taxon_id.description: Restrict to this taxon and its descendants. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

term_id.description: Annotation attribute ids, from inaturalist_list_reference topic controlled_terms — e.g. 1 for Life Stage. Multiple ids match any one annotation, not all annotations; arrays are membership sets, not positional pairs.

term_value_id.description: Annotation value ids, from the same attribute listing — e.g. 6 for Larva. Requires term_id. Multiple ids match any one annotation with an attribute in term_id and a value in this set, not both annotations.

threatened.description: Filter the observation’s indexed taxon as threatened at its location.

unobserved_by_user_id.description: Restrict to records of taxa this user has never observed, by numeric user id or login from inaturalist_resolve_name type user.

user_id.description: Restrict to one observer, by numeric user id from inaturalist_resolve_name type user. Mutually exclusive with user_login.

user_login.description: Restrict to one observer, by login — the login on an inaturalist_resolve_name user candidate, a leaderboard entry, or an observation’s observer. Mutually exclusive with user_id.

name: inaturalist_get_species_counts

applied_filters.description: The server-applied defaults that determine what this answer means.

captive.description: Captive-only when true, wild-only when false.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `inverted_rank_range`: hrank is a finer rank level than lrank. `unknown_place_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because place_id does not exist. `invalid_geography`: An area was given partially, in two forms at once, with a radius of 0 or less, or with nelat south of swlat. `inverted_date_range`: d1 is after d2. `unpaired_annotation_value`: term_value_id was supplied without term_id. `conflicting_observer`: user_id and user_login were both supplied. `unknown_taxon_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon_id does not exist. `unknown_user`: iNaturalist answered 422 because user_id, user_login, ident_user_id, or unobserved_by_user_id names no user. `unknown_project_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the project_id does not exist. `rate_budget_exhausted`: This server has spent its daily iNaturalist request budget for the current UTC day. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, when the page is past the last one holding taxa, or how to reach the taxa beyond this page.

shown.description: How many taxa this page carries.

species.description: The taxa, ranked by observation_count, most-observed first, each at its absolute position.

items.description: One leaf taxon and how often it was recorded in the requested area and period.

common_name.description: Preferred common name, when one is recorded.

iconic_taxon_name.description: Broad organism group, e.g. "Aves". Usable as an iconic_taxa filter value.

observation_count.description: How many matching observations record this taxon. The ranking key.

photo.description: Representative photo, when the taxon carries one.

attribution.description: Verbatim attribution; reproduce with any use of the image.

license_code.description: Photo licence code. Null means all rights reserved, independent of the record.

medium_url.description: Medium image URL; derived from the size path if needed. Absent when no variant is available.

open.description: True when served from the open-licence host at fetch time; licences can change.

square_url.description: 75px square variant, exactly as upstream published it. Null when absent.

position.description: Absolute place in this ranking, counted from page 1 — 7 is the seventh most-observed taxon. Not the taxonomic rank, which is rank.

taxon_id.description: Taxon id — pass it as taxon_id to any taxon-scoped tool or to inaturalist_get_taxon.

total_results.description: How many taxa match. An estimate over a live index — it drifts between calls seconds apart.

truncated.description: True when the page filled per_page and more taxa follow.

truncationCeiling.description: Observation count of the last taxon shown. The ranking is descending, so no taxon left off this page exceeds it.

title: Inaturalist Get Species Counts
